What this is

Interior window washing in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services washes interior windows — the inside glass and sills — for homes and commercial properties across Central Florida.

Clean outside glass behind dirty inside glass still looks dirty. Most customers book interior and exterior together, so the whole window is done on one visit.

What's involved

How it works, and what shapes the quote.

Residential and commercial, across Lake Mary, Heathrow, Altamonte Springs, Longwood and Orlando.

01

Tell us the rooms

Number of windows, and any that are hard to reach — tall entries, stairwells, high transoms.

02

Free estimate

A quote for the property, and a time that suits you.

03

Inside and out

Pair it with exterior window washing so each pane is finished both sides.

What affects the scope

  • Number of windows and rooms
  • High or hard-to-reach glass
  • Furniture or blinds in front of windows
  • Occupied home or empty property
  • Commercial storefront or office glass
  • Combining it with exterior windows

Every quote is based on the property itself — the estimate visit is where the measuring happens, and it is free.

Questions

Before you call.

Do I need to be home?

Yes — interior work needs someone to let the crew in. Agree a time on the estimate call.

Can you do inside and outside on the same day?

Yes. That is the most common way it is booked.

Do you do commercial interiors?

Yes, for commercial properties as well as homes.
